title: Crossing the Gender Binary: Modelling Gendered Reference in Science Fiction and General Fiction

bias_targets.methodology: Masking gendered and neutral human-reference terms (man/men, woman/women, person/people) in sentences from literary corpora, generating predictions using RoBERTa, and classifying the top-5 substitutes by gender to calculate retention, cross-category substitution rates, and entropy.
Evaluating the candidate prediction sets for masked gendered terms to measure the presence and frequency of sexual minority labels (e.g., homosexuals, gays, lesbians) emerging as substitutes.
Analyzing the candidate prediction sets for masked 'woman/women' terms to track the emergence of racial demographic categories (e.g., blacks) as substitutes.
Analyzing the candidate prediction sets for masked 'woman/women' terms to track the emergence of religious demographic categories (e.g., Jews, Muslims, Christians) as substitutes.
Monitoring candidate prediction sets for masked gendered terms to identify the inclusion of demographic and social categories such as 'immigrants'.
